# Filter rows where 'Notes' contains 'Filmfare Award for Best Actress'
# and not just a nomination (since some rows mention 'Nominated')
mask = df['Notes'].str.contains('Filmfare Award for Best Actress', na=False) & ~df['Notes'].str.contains('Nominated', na=False)
award_films = df[mask]

# Sort by year to find the earliest one
award_films_sorted = award_films.sort_values('Year')

# Get the first movie (earliest year)
first_award_movie = award_films_sorted.iloc[0]['Film']

answer = first_award_movie
